_comment: Prisma (games/prisma): the same ids as voice/fi.json.

clips.prisma_tip1: Turn the prism with your finger so the light hits the screen.
clips.prisma_tip2: Drag the screen further and closer. Measure the width of the colours in three places.
clips.prisma_tip3: Change what the prism is made of. How much does the light turn?
clips.prisma_tip4: Adjust the three lamps. Make yellow, magenta, cyan and white light.
clips.prisma_tip5: Change the colour of the light. Try all four.
clips.prisma_fact1: White light is many colours together. The prism bends each colour a little differently, and that makes a rainbow.
clips.prisma_fact2: The further the screen, the wider the colours spread.
clips.prisma_fact3: Glass bends light more than water, and air hardly at all.
clips.prisma_fact4: Red, green and blue light together look white.
clips.prisma_fact5: A prism does not make colours, it only separates them. One-coloured light has just one colour.
clips.prisma_tir: Oops! The light bounces inside the prism. Turn it a little more.
clips.prisma_measure1: Measured! Move the screen and measure again.
clips.prisma_measure3: Three measurements! See how the width changed.
clips.prisma_air: Air! The light goes straight through.
clips.prisma_water: Water! The light turns a little.
clips.prisma_glass: Glass! The light turns a lot.
clips.prisma_light_white: White light splits into a rainbow!
clips.prisma_q2: What happened to the colours when the screen went further?
clips.prisma_q3: What bent the light the most?
clips.prisma_q5: Why doesn't one-coloured light make a rainbow?
clips.prisma_hint2: Look at the measurements. Further away it was wider.
clips.prisma_hint3: Look how many degrees the light turned with each.
clips.prisma_hint5: White light has all colours. How many colours does red light have?
clips.prisma_right: Right! You are a real scientist!
